articles.title: Coinbase earnings: Wall Street divided on trading rebound after Robinhood crypto revenue sinks 55%
articles.snippet: Coinbase faces a key earnings test as analysts debate the strength of its trading rebound following a sharp drop in Robinhood's crypto revenue.

articles.title: Polymarket Has Investigated 'Dozens' of Midterm Election Bets: Report
articles.snippet: The firm's new head of investigations says its surveillance system flags hundreds of alerts a day, with at least two cases sent to the CFTC.
